rows.grounds: numeral element forming the count eighty-four thousand
locative plural indicating the quantity in which
past passive participle describing those afflicted

items.question: What affliction befalls beings within the eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams?
premises: Beings are situated within these womb-diagrams.
These beings experience torment in that condition.
items.inference: Existence within the eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams entails torment.
uncertainties: The subject of pīḍitāḥ is implied from the preceding context.
items.plain_english: They are tormented in the eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
